title: Kissed Canadian Roast Roast
description: Roasted, pillowy Canadian dish featuring demerara sugar. A low-sodium-friendly weeknight option.
instructions: Season the Canadian Roast Beef with salt, black pepper, and rosemary.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear the beef until browned on all sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the beef to a plate and set aside.
Add the minced garlic to the pot and sauté for 1 minute.
Pour in the beef broth, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot.
Return the beef to the pot, cover, and transfer to the preheated oven.
Roast for 2-3 hours, or until the beef reaches an internal temperature of 135°F (57°C) for medium-rare.
Remove the beef from the oven and brush with demerara sugar.
Increase the oven temperature to 400°F (200°C) and roast for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the sugar is caramelized.
Let the beef rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
Serve with the pan juices spooned over the top.
